notes: Open and the card's name now show its full grading page, with the scan view, every tab and its findings, straight away. Cardwright keeps that page for every card you grade, so you can delete the scan files and still see everything
Re-grade and measuring again still need the scans: if they're gone, the page says so and offers Pick its scans
Fixed prices for cards that only have a European price: a few odd sales no longer make a card look worth far more (a Pikachu promo showed about $1,950 instead of about $90)
Settings shows how much space the saved pages use
